jobs.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. Production Korean fantasy RPG inventory artwork, sumptuous painted metal, gemstones, crisp readable silhouettes, sophisticated luminous magic aura on uniform very dark navy backdrop. No text, no numbers, no labels, no characters. Exact equally sized grid cells. Each complete item INCLUDING halo fully inside its own cell with generous 18 percent safe margin, no touching edges or crossing cells. Every variant must be newly designed with radically distinct shape, construction, ornament and silhouette, NEVER mere recolors. Beautiful level 220 endgame equipment. Square atlas exactly 3 columns by 2 rows. FIVE distinct greatsword designs ordered left to right, top to bottom, last bottom-right cell empty dark. Five themes: star oath, nebula revelation, heavenly authority, genesis judgment, infinite royalty. Designs in exact order: slender meteor-forged single blade with star pommel; curved crescent saber with suspended orbital shards; broad angel-wing crossguard crystalline sword; split double-pronged creation blade with rotating clockwork core; colossal crown-shaped royal execution sword with floating concentric blade segments. Cohesive astral platinum/opalescent gold material language but each construction fundamentally different. All weapons diagonal and fully visible.
